Search

A search box: icon, clear button, an optional shortcut that focuses it, and a debounced ray-search event. A RayInput, so it has a label and takes part in forms.

ray-search: once the typing pauses
ray-search fires 200 ms after the last key (debounce); input fires on every key.

API

<ray-search> · RaySearch

Escape clears it (when it has text); Enter fires ray-search at once. JS: clear(), focus().

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
valuevaluestringCurrent text.
placeholderplaceholderstringSearch…Placeholder text.
shortcutshortcutstringKeyboard shortcut that focuses it ("mod+k", "/"; mod = ⌘ on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere). Shown as a hint while empty.
debouncedebouncenumber200Milliseconds of quiet typing before ray-search fires (0: on every keystroke).
namename reflectsstringForm field name.
labellabelstringVisible label (also the accessible name). Without it, use aria-label.
disableddisabledbooleanNot editable nor submitted.
sizesize reflectsxs | sm | md | lg | xlsmHeight and font size.
radiusradiusxs | sm | md | lg | xl | fullCorner radius.
variantvariant reflectsdefault | filled | unstyledfilledBox style.
EventDescription
inputOn every edit (value already updated).
ray-searchAfter `debounce` ms without typing, on Enter, and when cleared.
